ops.en: The third imperative to Noach (TIR-027): BO — 'COME' (not 'enter': the command-verb speaks from inside the ark [letter fact, held; the chain's readings are named-only; Onkelos flattens to 'enter']). The demand enters the queue with the household attached: you and all your house.

THE CORPUS'S FIRST PERSON-VERDICT: the seeing-verb (raiti, first person) with a verdict-adjective aimed at a MAN — 'YOU have I seen RIGHTEOUS before Me.' The instrument roster grows: tov (the week), shaah (the offerings), now TZADDIK — token 2 of the word, gone second person (6:9 was the narrator's). And the letter shifts number across the two verses: the narrator said in-his-GENERATIONS (plural);…

ops.x: noach, tevah are READ without prior install (gen_16's builder and build, resumed)
ops.en: flag, not fix

TAHOR ('pure/clean') — THE LAW'S CENTRAL ADJECTIVE, FIRST TOKENS — born in cargo arithmetic two chapters before its altar explains it (token 5 = 8:20: the clean sevens are sacrifice-stock) and long before any purity law exists [OPEN: how Noach knows clean from not-clean — the chain's question; named-only]. The pairs are counted ISH VE-ISHTO ('a MAN and his WIFE') — the human marriage-words applied…

THE VERSE PAYS EXTRA LETTERS TO AVOID A COARSE WORD [claim G17-10]. Where the single word טְמֵאָה (temeah, 'impure') was available, our 7:2 writes אֲשֶׁר לֹא טְהֹרָה ('which is NOT pure') and 7:8 writes אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנָּה טְהֹרָה - both circumlocutions verified in the ink at derivation. The rule drawn: never let a coarse word leave your mouth, since Scripture spent extra letters to avoid one even ab…
The mission clause: to keep SEED alive — ZERA, 3:15's contested word and 4:25's replacement word, now the conservation target for the whole earth. The ark's purpose stated in the enmity-verse's noun.

The countdown stack: SEVEN more days, onto FORTY day/night, onto gen_15's 120. ANOKHI MAMTIR — the rain-verb's token 2 as imminence participle (TIR-031): token 1 was creation WITHHOLDING rain (2:5, lo himtir); token 3 will rain fire on Sodom. U-MACHITI (weqatal, TIR-029) — the wipe-verb's token 2: gen_15's open resolve restated as a schedule, its object now YEQUM ('the standing-substance' — three …

COMPLIANCE REFRAIN #2 (6:22 was the first — Elohim; this one YHWH: the names alternate across the four refrains [letter fact]). Held as standing fact: the preparations receipted in summary; the COME-demand itself stays open — its own receipt is the entry (7:7), in its own verb.
The age-marker: 600 at the flood — gen_14's open row (Noach at 500, the ledger's unfinished line) advanced a century; the date-verse (7:11) will anchor the same number as a calendar epoch.

The command's own verb returns as the deed: BO ('come!') -> VA-YAVO ('and he came') — the echo-receipt class (gen_09's make->built; gen_16's make->made). The whole household boards. MI-PNEI MEI HA-MABUL — 'from before the waters' [letter fact, held; the chain's he-hesitated reading is named-only].

The bo-demand POPPED — SETTLED CYCLE #2: gen_16 settled make-and-take with one formula; the boarding settles come with the coming itself. The queue empties six verses into the unit; everything after is manifest and seal.
The four cargo classes restated for the boarding log — clean, not-clean (EINENAH — the is-not word, 5:24's einenu in the feminine: the vanish-word now a taxonomy negation), birds, creepers.

SELF-LOADING CONFIRMED: BAU — 'they CAME' (perfect): the promise of 6:20 (they shall come) is narrated fact — the cargo delivers itself two by two; Noach receives, never herds. And COMPLIANCE REFRAIN #3 (Elohim — the names alternate: Elohim, YHWH, Elohim, Elohim-then-YHWH).
The seven-day countdown of 7:4 elapses on schedule — the corpus's first kept forecast interval: announced, waited, arrived.

THE DELAY IS READ AS MOURNING [claim G17-13]. The seven days are explained as the mourning for Methuselah the righteous, whose merit DELAYED the punishment - the righteous suspending wrath in life and in death - or as God keeping seven days of mourning for His world before destroying it. From the latter, the allowance of mourning BEFORE a death is noted as unique to the One who knows the future. […

THE CORPUS'S FIRST FULL CALENDAR DATE — year 600 of one man's life, month TWO, day SEVENTEEN — and the TIME register takes its first CALENDAR value (gen_08's anchor was a construct-phrase; this is a timestamp). CHODESH ('month') debuts inside the date itself (first tokens x2): the calendar's own vocabulary is born dating the flood. The epoch is a private life: the world's clock runs on Noach's yea…

NIVKEU — the split-verb's FIRST token (niphal, agentless, TIR-032): the fountains of TEHOM — 1:2's deep, its second token — burst from below (the verb's career: Abraham splits the binding's wood, 22:3; the sea splits, Exod 14:16). Day 2 bounded the waters; the bound breaks upward.

And from above: ARUBOT HA-SHAMAYIM — 'heaven's windows' (a two-token Torah word: opened here, shut at 8:2) — NIFTACHU (agentless again, TIR-032). The double breach: day 2's separation of waters-above from waters-below fails in BOTH directions on one dated day — the un-creation's biggest structural move, executed as plumbing.

THE PUNISHMENT IS SPELLED OUT OF THE CRIME'S OWN VOCABULARY [claim G17-14]. They set their EYES on what was forbidden, and He opened the WELLSPRINGS above and below - the two words sharing a root, so this operator's event is read as the crime's word turned against it. [folded shape: cross-corpus link]

THE DATE IS DISPUTED BECAUSE THE YEAR'S START IS [claim G17-12]. This operator dates the breach to 'the SECOND month', and the ordinal resolves differently depending on whether the year begins in Nisan or in Tishrei - one reckoning giving Marcheshvan, the other Iyar. Both tie the date to the setting of the Pleiades, and one reads God as having removed two stars from that constellation to open the …

A QUANTIFIER PRESENT AT THE OPENING AND ABSENT AT THE CLOSE [claim G17-15]. Our 7:11 breaches ALL the wellsprings of the great deep; 8:2 dams 'the wellsprings' WITHOUT the word all. R. Elazar reads the missing quantifier as leaving some open, and names them - the hot springs of Tiberias, of Chamat Gader, and the cave of Banyas. A word missing from the closing operator is read as a permanent physic…

GESHEM ('rain-shower') — the noun's first token (its second, 8:2, is its being restrained): the announced forty runs. The 2:5 problem — no rain yet, no man to work the ground — is answered at scale: rain arrives to unwork it.

THE SCHEDULE IS RECONSTRUCTED FROM THIS UNIT'S OWN DATE OPERATORS [claim G17-11]. The ruling that the judgment lasted TWELVE MONTHS is a canonical case-table row, the first of five such judgments. From our date-formulas the chain works the calendar to the day - forty days of rain, a hundred and fifty of swell, the ark resting on the seventeenth, recession at one cubit per four days - and from that…

BE-ETZEM HA-YOM HA-ZEH ('on this very day') — THE SOLEMN- DATE FORMULA'S FIRST TOKEN: the stamp the corpus reserves for its hinge-days (next: the circumcision day, 17:23/26; the exodus day, Exod 12:17/41/51; Moses' ascent). Minted here: boarding day is the first day the letter refuses to let blur. The eight are counted by name and station — four men, four women, none omitted.

The taxonomy at full spread: by-its-kind FOUR times (the week's classification word at its densest since day 6), closing on the widest clause in the manifest: KOL TZIPPOR KOL KANAF — 'every bird, every WING' (tzippor debuts — token 2 is the covenant pieces, 15:10; kanaf's token 1 was day 5): the boarding list ends by counting wings.

The animals' own come-event (agentless of any herder — they come TO Noach): the criterion is RUACH CHAYIM ('the breath of life' — 2:7's gift, 6:17's target-list term): what the flood will reach is exactly what the ark receives.
The intake summarized (the come-root three ways in one verse: the comers... came... as commanded) — COMPLIANCE REFRAIN #4, and the fourth is split-voiced: ELOHIM commanded...

...and YHWH SHUT HIM IN. SAGAR token 2 — token 1 is 2:21 (God closing the FLESH after taking the rib; tokens 3-4 are Lot's door against the mob): every early closure in the corpus is a protective closure, and this one is the Judge's own hand on the rescue's door. The names split inside one verse — Elohim commands the intake, YHWH seals it [letter fact, held; the chain's justice/mercy reading is na…

ENTERED BY LEAVE, THEREFORE EXITS ONLY BY LEAVE [claim G17-17]. The entry command and its compliance, then the exit command and its compliance, are read as a closed four-verse obedience loop spanning this unit and the exit unit. He is read as REFUSING to leave and resume procreation until given an oath that no second flood will come. And the shutting-in here is read through the psalm's 'release me…
